description: New token launches on Base with a real sell test: every new Base pool (Uniswap v2/v3/v4, Aerodrome) found minutes after it opens, each token graded BASED, MID, COOKED or RADIOACTIVE from a buy and full sell simulated in one block (UNTESTED when no pool can be simulated). Poll with since=<nextSince> so you pay only for new rows; optional limit and min_liq. A feed older than 15 minutes is refused before payment. Facts, never advice. $0.01 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: base_launch_feed
